description: Have Influensea write a post in the user's voice from an idea, your notes and their saved resources, and save it as a draft for review. Spends the workspace's AI tokens, like generating in the app. Never publishes. Returns the draft.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse the same key to retry without generating (and paying) twice.

notes.description: Your notes or a rough draft to build from, e.g. points from the conversation.

prompt.description: What the post is about and who it is for.

resourceIds.description: Resource ids from resources_list to write from.

title.description: A short internal name for the draft.

name: drafts_generate
title: Generate a draft in the user's voice
